sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantan.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: When you imagine a powerful person, what comes to mind?
sentences.zh: 当你想象一个有权势的人时，你会想到什么？

sentences.en: In Gaffney, we had our own brand of diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 在加夫尼，我们有自己的一套外交手段。

sentences.en: Shake with your right hand, but hold a rock in your left.
sentences.zh: 右手握手，左手握石。

sentences.en: Perhaps you don't picture someone as evil as Frank Underwood from House of Cards.
sentences.zh: 也许你脑海中浮现的并不是《纸牌屋》里弗兰克·安德伍德那样邪恶的人。

sentences.en: But you also probably don't think of someone very nice.
sentences.zh: 但你可能也不会想到一个非常友善的人。

sentences.en: We don't normally associate power with qualities like compassion and kindness.
sentences.zh: 我们通常不会把权力和同情心、善良等品质联系在一起。

sentences.en: But the psychologist Dr. Keltner at UC Berkeley says, maybe we should.
sentences.zh: 但加州大学伯克利分校的心理学家达彻·凯尔特纳博士说，也许我们应该这样做。

sentences.en: What the science is finding is that kids at school, kids in summer camps, people in colleges, people in organizations,
sentences.zh: 科学研究发现，无论是学校里的孩子、夏令营里的孩子、大学生，还是组织机构中的成员，

sentences.en: if they are emotionally intelligent and really focus on others and even practice generosity, they rise in social power.
sentences.zh: 如果他们具备情商，真正关注他人，甚至践行慷慨，他们就会在社会权力中崛起。

sentences.en: Dr. Keltner studies power dynamics, and he's found something that might seem counterintuitive.
sentences.zh: 凯尔特纳博士研究权力动态，他发现了一些看似反直觉的东西。

sentences.en: If you think of power as all about Machiavellian scheming.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为权力全是关于马基雅维利式的权谋。

sentences.en: The people who display altruism, kindness, social intelligence.
sentences.zh: 那些表现出利他主义、善良和社会智慧的人。

sentences.en: Docker finds that these are the people who gain power and respect from their peers.
sentences.zh: 凯尔特纳发现，正是这些人从同伴那里获得了权力和尊重。

sentences.en: But there's a catch.
sentences.zh: 但这里有个陷阱。

sentences.en: Once these people become powerful,
sentences.zh: 一旦这些人变得有权势，

sentences.en: power tends to undermine the very qualities that help them get there in the first place.
sentences.zh: 权力往往会削弱那些最初帮助他们获得权力的品质。

sentences.en: There's something about the seductions of power
sentences.zh: 权力的诱惑中存在某种东西，

sentences.en: that makes you lose sight of ethics and other people's interests.
sentences.zh: 让你忽视了道德和他人的利益。

sentences.en: Dakar Keltner is the author of the new book, The Power Paradox, How We Gain and Lose Influence.
sentences.zh: 达彻·凯尔特纳是新书《权力悖论：我们如何获得和失去影响力》的作者。

sentences.en: We think his ideas are especially relevant right now when so many people are vying for power in this election season.
sentences.zh: 我们认为他的观点在当下尤为重要，因为在这个选举季，有这么多人正在争夺权力。

sentences.en: Dakar, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 达彻，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: It's great to be with you, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起，尚卡尔。

sentences.en: I'm fascinated by the research that you cite in the book, Dakar, that suggests that power shapes nearly all of our relationships.
sentences.zh: 达彻，你书中引用的研究让我着迷，它表明权力塑造了我们几乎所有的关系。

sentences.en: If you put a bunch of 13-year-old kids in a room, you say that power dynamics quickly emerge.
sentences.zh: 如果你把一群13岁的孩子放在一个房间里，你会发现权力动态很快就会出现。

sentences.en: And you make the case that kids who are kinder and more empathetic are the ones who quickly assume the mantle of power in the group.
sentences.zh: 你提出一个观点，即那些更善良、更有同理心的孩子，往往会迅速在群体中承担起权力的重任。

sentences.en: So you're right on both counts, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 所以你两点都说对了，尚卡尔。

sentences.en: I mean, first of all, you know, one of the things that we've learned in the science of power is that really power dynamics, who's influencing whom,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，你知道，我们在权力科学中学到的一件事是，真正的权力动态，即谁在影响谁，

sentences.en: shape every relationship from parent-child dynamics to dynamics in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 塑造了从亲子关系到美国参议院内部动态的每一种关系。

sentences.en: Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议院。

sentences.en: And then, you know, what we've discovered over the past 20 years is probably a little bit counterintuitive, and it challenges older ideas about power, more Machiavellian ideas.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我们在过去20年里发现的东西可能有点反直觉，它挑战了关于权力的旧观念，即更偏向马基雅维利式的观念。

sentences.en: And what the science is finding is that kids at school, kids in summer camps, people in colleges, people in organizations,
sentences.zh: 科学研究发现，无论是学校里的孩子、夏令营里的孩子、大学生，还是组织机构中的成员，

sentences.en: if they are emotionally intelligent and really focus on others and even practice generosity, they rise in social power.
sentences.zh: 如果他们具备情商，真正关注他人，甚至践行慷慨，他们就会在社会权力中崛起。

sentences.en: I have to say, as I hear that, I have some skepticism.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，听到这些，我持有一些怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And this might be because you attended nicer schools than I did.
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为你上的学校比我上的要好。

sentences.en: But my experience of middle school felt, you know, more emotionally like the Hunger Games,
sentences.zh: 但我对中学的经历感觉，你知道，在情感上更像是《饥饿游戏》，

sentences.en: that kids who were stronger and louder and meaner often got their way.
sentences.zh: 那些更强壮、声音更大、更刻薄的孩子往往能如愿以偿。

sentences.en: I mean, is my experience an aberration?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我的经历是个特例吗？

sentences.en: Well, I don't know where you went to school, but it tends to be an aberration.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道你在哪里上的学，但这往往是个特例。

sentences.en: So what these studies do is they take a group of seventh graders.
sentences.zh: 这些研究的做法是选取一组七年级的学生。

sentences.en: You find out who has respect and esteem at the start of the year.
sentences.zh: 你在学年初找出谁拥有尊重和威望。

sentences.en: You study what their social behaviors are, their social strategies, and then you track how they do in the hierarchy of that seventh grade class, to use your example.
sentences.zh: 你研究他们的社会行为、社会策略，然后追踪他们在七年级班级等级制度中的表现，以你的例子来说。

sentences.en: And, you know, what you find is, yes, the bullies and the Machiavellians, the sociopaths, they get a little bit of attention early.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你发现的是，是的，那些霸凌者、马基雅维利主义者、反社会者，他们早期确实得到了一些关注。

sentences.en: But over the long haul, and this is true in other contexts, they don't have as much power as they would like to.
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，在其他环境中也是如此，他们并没有获得他们想要的那么多权力。

sentences.en: And instead, what studies find now numbering in the dozens, it's really the connecting kid, the empathetic kid, the kid who's really open and curious,
sentences.zh: 相反，现在的研究（数量已达数十项）发现，真正崛起并获得班级威望和地位的，是那些善于建立联系的孩子、有同理心的孩子，以及那些真正开放和好奇的孩子。

sentences.en: who really rises in the esteem and the ranks of the class.
sentences.zh: 他们真正提升了在班级中的威望和地位。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if this really comes down to thinking about power in two different ways.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否归结为以两种不同的方式思考权力。

sentences.en: The power that I'm hearing you talk about is really reputational power.
sentences.zh: 我听你谈论的权力实际上是声誉权力。

sentences.en: You know, I think of Doctors Without Borders, for example, as having reputational power.
sentences.zh: 你知道，例如，我认为“无国界医生”组织拥有声誉权力。

sentences.en: They don't, you know, they don't cut my paycheck and they can't fire me, but I pay attention to what they say because I respect them as an organization.
sentences.zh: 他们不，你知道，他们不给我发工资，也不能解雇我，但我关注他们所说的话，因为我尊重他们作为一个组织。

sentences.en: On the other hand, when you have coercive power, people who can punish you or people who can take away your life or your freedom, it feels like maybe,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，当你拥有强制性权力时，那些可以惩罚你，或者可以剥夺你的生命或自由的人，感觉好像，

sentences.en: is it possible that those two different, there are two different paths to power for those two different kinds of power?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能这两种不同的权力有两条不同的通往权力的路径？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And I mean, that's a wonderful observation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个非常棒的观察。

sentences.en: And so one of the things that the science of power has done, which I report on in The Power Paradox, is to take a step back and think, what do we really mean by power?
sentences.zh: 所以权力科学所做的一件事，我在《权力悖论》中也报道过，就是退后一步思考，我们所说的权力到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: You know, we intuitively define it as money, but a lot of things happen in the world that are independent of capital.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们直觉上把它定义为金钱，但世界上发生了很多独立于资本的事情。

sentences.en: We might think of it historically as military might, but you can easily come up with counterexamples where immense military might actually produces weakness.
sentences.zh: 我们可能在历史上认为它是军事力量，但你可以很容易地举出反例，巨大的军事力量实际上产生了软弱。

sentences.en: And so we have to kind of problematize it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须对它进行某种程度的问题化。

sentences.en: And what the field has done is thought about one strategy to power that works in certain contexts is a kind of a coercive, top-down Machiavellian strategy.
sentences.zh: 该领域所做的是思考一种在特定环境下有效的权力策略，即一种强制性的、自上而下的马基雅维利式策略。

sentences.en: Another kind is a more socially intelligent strategy that involves some of these things we've been talking about.
sentences.zh: 另一种是更具社会智慧的策略，涉及我们一直在谈论的一些事情。

sentences.en: And you know what's really interesting, Shankar,
sentences.zh: 你知道最有趣的是什么吗，尚卡尔，

sentences.en: and one of the things that inspired me to write this book is a lot of data that have been summarized by people like Alice Eggly finding that our conception of power is moving from coercive strategies to more collaborative strategies.
sentences.zh: 启发我写这本书的原因之一是爱丽丝·伊格利等人总结的大量数据，发现我们对权力的概念正在从强制性策略转向更协作的策略。

sentences.en: So it's one of the reasons I wrote this book.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我写这本书的原因之一。

sentences.en: So when you describe this kind of power that is more reputational, by that account, you
sentences.zh: 所以当你描述这种更偏向声誉的权力时，按照这个说法，你

sentences.en: would say, you know, the United States' power in the world is not just a reflection of the
sentences.zh: 会说，你知道，美国在世界上的权力不仅仅反映了其

sentences.en: strength of its military and the size of its armed forces.
sentences.zh: 军事力量的强大和武装部队的规模。

sentences.en: It's really about the power of its ideas and its ability to do well in the world.
sentences.zh: 它实际上关乎其思想的力量以及在世界上做好事的能力。

sentences.en: Is that the argument you're making, that this kind of soft power in some ways is more
sentences.zh: 这就是你的论点吗，即这种软实力在某种程度上比我们通常与权力联系在一起的硬实力更

sentences.en: important than the hard power that we've come to associate with power?
sentences.zh: 重要？

sentences.en: Well, this is one of the ideas that really spurred the science of power in our lab and other labs for the past 20 years, which is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是过去20年来真正推动我们实验室和其他实验室进行权力科学研究的观点之一，那就是，你知道，

sentences.en: if you think about the influence the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果你思考美国对普通世界公民的影响力，

sentences.en: has on the average world citizen, part of it is through the flow of capital and economics and part of it is, you know, having this expansive military.
sentences.zh: 部分是通过资本和经济的流动，部分是，你知道，拥有这种扩张性的军事力量。

sentences.en: But a bigger component or dimension to our power is how do we shape the thinking of people around the world?
sentences.zh: 但我们权力中一个更大的组成部分或维度是我们如何塑造世界各地人们的思维？

sentences.en: How do we shape the emotions of people around the world or what they deem to be fair or right?
sentences.zh: 我们如何塑造世界各地人们的情绪，或者他们认为什么是公平或正确的？

sentences.en: And that comes through books.
sentences.zh: 这通过书籍来实现。

sentences.en: It comes through forms of art.
sentences.zh: 它通过艺术形式来实现。

sentences.en: It comes through journalism.
sentences.zh: 它通过新闻业来实现。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, I took that thinking of soft power, if you will, which in some ways is harder, and really extended it to the personal realm, which is that as a parent,
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，我采用了这种软实力的想法（如果你愿意的话），它在某些方面更难，并真正将其扩展到了个人领域，那就是作为父母，

sentences.en: you know, yeah, I have economic control over my kids.
sentences.zh: 你知道，是的，我对我的孩子有经济控制权。

sentences.en: I'm bigger than they are.
sentences.zh: 我比他们大。

sentences.en: But really, I also influence them through ideas, through preferences that I enable, through the context that I put them in.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我也通过思想、通过我启用的偏好、通过我让他们所处的环境来影响他们。

sentences.en: So power is much more than economic or military might.
sentences.zh: 所以权力远不止是经济或军事力量。

sentences.en: It's really how we influence the states of other people.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是我们如何影响他人的状态。

sentences.en: You talk in the book about the story of Abraham Lincoln and cite his rise to power as a classic example of what you're talking about, the skills that you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 你在书中谈到了亚伯拉罕·林肯的故事，并引用他权力的崛起作为你所谈论内容的经典例子，即你所谈论的那些技能。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, one of the things I did, Shankar, you know, in the three years of writing this book, and really while I've been doing the science of power,
sentences.zh: 你知道，尚卡尔，我在写这本书的三年里，实际上是在我进行权力科学研究的同时，我所做的一件事，

sentences.en: is just to read broadly on the biographies of great leaders, the historical accounts of important social change.
sentences.zh: 就是广泛阅读伟大领袖的传记，阅读重要社会变革的历史记录。

sentences.en: And, you know, what I encountered is time and time again that there are these examples,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我一次又一次地遇到这些例子，

sentences.en: very compelling examples of great leaders who lead through advancing the interests of other people.
sentences.zh: 非常引人注目的例子，伟大的领袖通过推进他人的利益来领导。

sentences.en: You know, I mean, Abraham Lincoln was such a compelling example, you know, and I love this observation about him of Thurlow Weed,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的意思是，亚伯拉罕·林肯就是一个如此引人注目的例子，你知道，我喜欢瑟洛·威德对他的观察，

sentences.en: who was a journalist at the time and a close student of the politics of Lincoln's era.
sentences.zh: 他当时是一位记者，也是林肯时代政治的密切研究者。

sentences.en: And he's like, what is it about Lincoln that accounts for his really unpredicted rise in power?
sentences.zh: 他说，林肯身上有什么东西能解释他那真正出人意料的权力崛起？

sentences.en: He's a poor guy, awkward, didn't have all the advantages that often give you power.
sentences.zh: 他是个穷小子，笨拙，没有那些通常能给你带来权力的优势。

sentences.en: And he said, Thurlow Weed said, you know, Lincoln sees and hears everybody who comes to him.
sentences.zh: 他说，瑟洛·威德说，你知道，林肯会见并倾听每一个来找他的人。

sentences.en: He just engages in the interests of others.
sentences.zh: 他只是参与到他人的利益中。

sentences.en: And then when I read that and then I heard about the science, for example,
sentences.zh: 然后当我读到这一点，又听到关于科学的研究，例如，

sentences.en: of Stéphane Côté showing it's really these emotionally intelligent managers in workplaces that rise in the ranks and build strong teams, I saw this nice convergence of evidence.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·科特的研究表明，在工作场所中，真正崛起并建立强大团队的是那些高情商的管理者，我看到了这种证据的完美融合。

sentences.en: When we come back, I'm going to ask Dakar about several experiments he's conducted that show that even as kindness and empathy can give rise to power,
sentences.zh: 回来后，我要问达彻关于他进行的几项实验，这些实验表明，即使善良和同理心可以带来权力，

sentences.en: having power can undermine kindness and empathy.
sentences.zh: 拥有权力也会削弱善良和同理心。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.zh: Care.com HomePay 让一切变得简单，

sentences.en: Hi there, I'm Maggie Penman.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是玛吉·彭曼。

sentences.zh: 我是《隐藏的大脑》的制作人之一，鼓励大家下载 NPR One 应用程序。

sentences.en: As summer winds down, it's a great way to find new shows and stories for those lovely last road trips to the beach.
sentences.zh: 随着夏日渐行渐远，这是为那些去海滩的美好最后公路旅行寻找新节目和故事的好方法。

sentences.en: Or if vacation is over for you, maybe you could download it before your morning commute.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你的假期已经结束，也许你可以在早晨通勤前下载它。

sentences.en: Basically, you should just download it.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你应该下载它。

sentences.en: It's in your app store, NPRONE.
sentences.zh: 它在你的应用商店里，NPRONE。

sentences.en: Dacher, you've done a lot of work looking not just at the forces that give rise to power,
sentences.zh: 达彻，你做了很多工作，不仅研究了带来权力的力量，

sentences.en: these forces of empathy and generosity and kindness,
sentences.zh: 这些同理心、慷慨和善良的力量，

sentences.en: but also what power does to those forces in turn,
sentences.zh: 还研究了权力反过来对这些力量的影响，

sentences.en: that when people acquire power, it seems to change their ability to be empathetic, to be kind.
sentences.zh: 即当人们获得权力时，似乎改变了他们同理心和善良的能力。

sentences.en: Talk about that.
sentences.zh: 谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Well, this was some of the more dramatic work that we engaged in, you know, that's now been replicated in a lot of different places.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我们参与的一些更具戏剧性的工作，你知道，现在已经在许多不同的地方得到了复制。

sentences.en: And that's why I call the book The Power Paradox, which is, you know, if you look at this social science of power, we get power through, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我把这本书称为《权力悖论》，即，你知道，如果你看看权力的社会科学，我们通过，你知道，

sentences.en: the pro-social tendencies that we are endowed with.
sentences.zh: 我们被赋予的亲社会倾向来获得权力。

sentences.en: But then once we feel powerful or we come from a background of privilege and feeling above others, we lose those tendencies.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们感到有权势，或者我们来自特权背景并感到高人一等，我们就会失去这些倾向。

sentences.en: So let me give you an example.
sentences.zh: 让我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: You know, there are a lot of studies that show that empathetic practices get you power.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有很多研究表明，同理心实践能带给你权力。

sentences.en: So one of my favorites is work by Woolley and colleagues showing, you know, you give teams these complex problems to solve.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的研究之一是伍利及其同事的工作，你知道，你给团队这些复杂的难题去解决。

sentences.en: And it's really the more empathetic individuals that make their team stronger and perform better, right?
sentences.zh: 真正让团队更强大、表现更好的是那些更有同理心的个人，对吧？

sentences.en: They're listening well.
sentences.zh: 他们善于倾听。

sentences.en: They're asking good questions.
sentences.zh: 他们提出好的问题。

sentences.en: They're paying attention to other people.
sentences.zh: 他们关注他人。

sentences.en: So empathy makes the team and the individual stronger.
sentences.zh: 所以同理心让团队和个人都变得更强大。

sentences.en: And then what we started to show in our lab is once we feel powerful, we lose or our capacity to empathize and to know what others are thinking really is diminished.
sentences.zh: 然后我们实验室开始展示的是，一旦我们感到有权势，我们就会失去同理心，或者我们了解他人想法的能力确实会减弱。

sentences.en: So in one study, really simple, we, you know, bring people to the lab.
sentences.zh: 所以在一项研究中，非常简单，我们，你知道，把人们带到实验室。

sentences.en: We have them engage in this exercise where they compare themselves to sort of the real poor people of society and it makes them feel powerful.
sentences.zh: 我们让他们参与这个练习，将自己与社会上真正的穷人进行比较，这让他们感到有权势。

sentences.en: Or they compare themselves to the kind of the elite of society and they feel, as a result of that comparison, less power.
sentences.zh: 或者他们将自己与社会精英进行比较，结果他们感到权力较小。

sentences.en: And then we just present them some photos of people expressing different emotions with subtle muscle movements around the eyes, like concentration or flirtatious or decisive.
sentences.zh: 然后我们只是向他们展示一些照片，照片上的人通过眼睛周围细微的肌肉运动表达不同的情绪，比如专注、调情或果断。

sentences.en: And what we find is when you feel powerful, you lose your ability to read emotion in people's facial expressions.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，当你感到有权势时，你就会失去解读人们面部表情中情绪的能力。

sentences.en: Why would that happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, there are a couple of deep reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，有几个深层原因。

sentences.en: One is, you know, and this is just striking research by Kili Muscatel and Sukhpandir Obdi, which is that, you know, Shankar, if I feel powerful,
sentences.zh: 一个是，你知道，这是基利·马斯卡特尔和苏克潘迪尔·奥布迪的惊人研究，那就是，你知道，尚卡尔，如果我感到有权势，

sentences.en: the studies show I just feel less interested in other people, less invested in them.
sentences.zh: 研究表明我只是对他人感到不那么感兴趣，对他们的投入也更少。

sentences.en: And as a result, the empathy networks in the brain are actually quieted.
sentences.zh: 结果，大脑中的同理心网络实际上被抑制了。

sentences.en: They're less active.
sentences.zh: 它们不太活跃。

sentences.en: So Keely Muscatel brought people to the lab.
sentences.zh: 所以基利·马斯卡特尔把人们带到实验室。

sentences.en: She had them sort of think about another student's daily life.
sentences.zh: 她让他们思考另一个学生的日常生活。

sentences.en: And if you come from a position of privilege and power,
sentences.zh: 如果你来自一个拥有特权和权力的位置，

sentences.en: the classic empathy networks in the frontal lobes of your brain are not even active when you're thinking about another student.
sentences.zh: 当你想到另一名学生时，大脑额叶中经典的共情网络甚至都不会活跃。

sentences.en: So this is a very deep effect of what power does to our empathic capacities.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是权力对我们共情能力所产生的非常深远的影响。

sentences.en: So what you're saying in some ways is that we are empathetic to others in part because that's useful to us.
sentences.zh: 所以你某种程度上是在说，我们对他人产生共情，部分原因是因为这对我们有用。

sentences.en: We lack power in many situations.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，我们缺乏权力。

sentences.en: And being empathetic and being aware of others allows us to navigate our social worlds effectively.
sentences.zh: 而保持共情并关注他人，能让我们有效地驾驭社交世界。

sentences.en: But when we perceive ourselves having power and privilege, in some ways, we don't need to depend as much as we do on others.
sentences.zh: 但当我们认为自己拥有权力和特权时，在某种程度上，我们就不需要像以前那样依赖他人了。

sentences.en: We don't need to reach out to others.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要向他人寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And so those networks shut down.
sentences.zh: 于是，那些网络就关闭了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No, really well put.
sentences.zh: 不，说得真好。

sentences.en: Because if you think about, for example, somebody who's poor and doesn't have a lot of resources, they're dependent on other people to get to work, to do a little bit of, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你想想，比如一个贫穷且资源匮乏的人，他们依赖他人才能去上班，才能做一点，你知道的，

sentences.en: ad hoc childcare or what have you.
sentences.zh: 临时的托儿服务之类的琐事。

sentences.en: So you're dependent on others.
sentences.zh: 所以你是依赖他人的。

sentences.en: And out of that state of mutual dependence, you really, with vigilance, attend to other people and are aware of what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 在这种相互依赖的状态下，你确实会保持警惕，关注他人，并了解他们在做什么。

sentences.en: And that produces these empathy benefits coming out of less power.
sentences.zh: 而这产生了因权力较小而带来的共情红利。

sentences.en: And then the compliment, you lose that empathy when you feel less dependent on others and powerful.
sentences.zh: 反过来说，当你感到不再那么依赖他人且拥有权力时，你就会失去那种共情能力。

sentences.en: So one of the paradoxes of this is something that you and others have identified,
sentences.zh: 所以，这其中的一个悖论，是你和其他人已经指出的，

sentences.en: which is to look at the generosity of people who are rich and poor, and you find some really surprising things.
sentences.zh: 那就是观察富人和穷人的慷慨程度，你会发现一些非常令人惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, again, what studies are finding, and, again, this is part of the power paradox,
sentences.zh: 所以，再次重申，研究发现——这也是权力悖论的一部分——

sentences.en: which is that there is this really interesting literature called competitive altruism.
sentences.zh: 那就是存在一种非常有趣的文献，称为“竞争性利他主义”。

sentences.en: And if you take the average person in a social network and they practice generosity and they share resources or they encourage others, through those acts of generosity,
sentences.zh: 如果你在社交网络中找一个普通人，他们实践慷慨，分享资源或鼓励他人，通过这些慷慨的行为，

sentences.en: they rise in power.
sentences.zh: 他们的权力地位就会上升。

sentences.en: People trust them.
sentences.zh: 人们信任他们。

sentences.en: They esteem them.
sentences.zh: 人们尊重他们。

sentences.en: You even see this in hunter-gatherer societies where it's really the individual who shares the most food in the hunter-gatherer societies who rises in the ranks.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以在狩猎采集社会中看到这一点，在这些社会中，真正地位上升的往往是分享食物最多的人。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, what we started to find with Paul Piff and other colleagues is once I feel powerful, I prove to be less generous.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我们开始与保罗·皮夫（Paul Piff）和其他同事一起发现的那样，一旦我感到自己有权力，我就变得不那么慷慨了。

sentences.en: So in one study, we brought people to the lab who varied in terms of their social class and family wealth.
sentences.zh: 所以在其中一项研究中，我们把社会阶层和家庭财富各不相同的人带到了实验室。

sentences.en: We just gave them a very simple opportunity to share resources with a stranger.
sentences.zh: 我们只是给了他们一个非常简单的机会，让他们与陌生人分享资源。

sentences.en: And we found it was really the poor who shared more.
sentences.zh: 结果我们发现，确实是穷人分享得更多。

sentences.en: And higher power people, more privileged people shared less.
sentences.zh: 而权力较高的人，即更优越的人，分享得更少。

sentences.en: Now, obviously, people who are millionaires and billionaires, they might be philanthropic
sentences.zh: 当然，那些百万富翁和亿万富翁，他们可能很热衷慈善，

sentences.en: and they might give larger amounts of money.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会捐出更多的钱。

sentences.en: But what you're really saying is it's a proportion of your wealth for a millionaire to give
sentences.zh: 但你真正想说的是，对于百万富翁来说，捐出财富的比例，

sentences.en: $1,000 is not the same thing as somebody at the poverty line who's giving 50.
sentences.zh: 1000美元并不等同于处于贫困线的人捐出50美元。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We always have to be careful about how we interpret these results.
sentences.zh: 我们总是必须谨慎对待如何解读这些结果。

sentences.en: And these are just proportions of sharing and not absolute amounts.
sentences.zh: 这些只是分享的比例，而不是绝对金额。

sentences.en: And you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: But you even get this experimentally.
sentences.zh: 但你甚至可以通过实验得到这个结论。

sentences.en: So, you know, in one of our early studies in power, we were interested in does experimentally produced power lead to kind of the hoarding of resources,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在我们早期关于权力的研究中，我们感兴趣的是，实验产生的权力是否会导致资源的囤积，

sentences.en: which we've been talking about.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们一直在谈论的那个问题。

sentences.en: We brought groups of three people to the lab.
sentences.zh: 我们把三个人一组带到实验室。

sentences.en: We randomly signed one individual to the position of power.
sentences.zh: 我们随机指定一个人担任权力职位。

sentences.en: And then by design, they went through this experiment.
sentences.zh: 然后按照设计，他们完成了这个实验。

sentences.en: It was kind of boring and they're writing policies for the university.
sentences.zh: 这有点无聊，他们正在为大学撰写政策。

sentences.en: and we brought in
sentences.zh: 我们在研究进行到一半时，

sentences.en: halfway through the study
sentences.zh: 拿进来

sentences.en: this plate of five
sentences.zh: 一盘五个

sentences.en: chocolate chip cookies.
sentences.zh: 巧克力曲奇。

sentences.en: Every member of the group,
sentences.zh: 小组中的每一位成员，

sentences.en: three people all together
sentences.zh: 总共三个人，

sentences.en: took a cookie
sentences.zh: 都拿了一块曲奇，

sentences.en: and so we asked
sentences.zh: 所以我们问，

sentences.en: who took that fourth cookie
sentences.zh: 是谁拿了第四块曲奇，

sentences.en: and it was our high power person
sentences.zh: 结果是我们那个拥有高权力的人，

sentences.en: who tended to take that cookie.
sentences.zh: 往往会拿走那块曲奇。

sentences.en: Not only that,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，

sentences.en: but they ate in this
sentences.zh: 他们吃的时候，

sentences.en: kind of impulsive way
sentences.zh: 那种冲动的方式，

sentences.en: where their lips were smacking,
sentences.zh: 嘴里吧唧作响，

sentences.en: mouths were open.
sentences.zh: 张着嘴。

sentences.en: Crumbs,
sentences.zh: 碎屑，

sentences.en: we took it seven months ago
sentences.zh: 我们七个月前做的实验，

sentences.en: there's crumbs falling
sentences.zh: 碎屑掉落

sentences.en: on their sweaters
sentences.zh: 在他们的毛衣上，

sentences.en: and again,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，

sentences.en: You know, what this tells us is really two things, Shankar, which is, you know, power does make us a little bit more self-focused.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这告诉我们两件事，尚卡尔（Shankar），那就是，权力确实让我们变得更加自我关注。

sentences.en: In this, you know, you're sharing less, you're keeping more for yourself, you're eating the cookie in an impulsive way.
sentences.zh: 在这点上，你分享得更少，为自己留得更多，你以一种冲动的方式吃曲奇。

sentences.en: But the other thing I think we shouldn't lose sight of is this can happen to us all, right?
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们不应忽视的另一件事是，这种情况可能发生在每个人身上，对吧？

sentences.en: This is just what the mind does when we feel powerful.
sentences.zh: 这就是当我们感到有权力时，大脑的自然反应。

sentences.en: Because, of course, these were just random people who are brought into the lab and you've randomly picked one of them to assign them a feeling of power.
sentences.zh: 因为当然，这些只是被带到实验室的随机人群，你随机挑选了其中一人，赋予他们一种权力感。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: You did mention there were five cookies and three people.
sentences.zh: 你提到有五块曲奇和三个人。

sentences.en: So what happened to the fifth cookie?
sentences.zh: 那么第五块曲奇发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, this was where it was really interesting because, you know, the rules of politeness
sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是最有趣的地方，因为你知道，礼貌的规则

sentences.en: suggest that you really should not be that uncouth person who takes the last cookie off
sentences.zh: 暗示你不应该成为那个粗鲁的人，从盘子里拿走最后一块曲奇。

sentences.en: the plate.
sentences.zh: 所以我们为实验做了预测试，没有人愿意拿走第四块曲奇。

sentences.en: And so we did pilot testing for the experiment and no one would take that fourth cookie.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么我们加了第五块曲奇，只是为了让某人能够自由地拿走倒数第二块曲奇。

sentences.en: So that's why we added a fifth cookie just to free somebody up to take that second to
sentences.zh: 所以这很迷人，因为当然，你在这些实验室实验中看到的情况，

sentences.en: last cookie.
sentences.zh: 往往反映在更大、更大的舞台上，在那里你看到掌权者滥用权力，

sentences.en: So it's fascinating because, of course, what you see in these lab experiments is often
sentences.zh: 你知道，搞婚外情、作弊，以及伪造财务报表。

sentences.en: reflected on much, much bigger stages where you see people in power abusing that power,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: you know, having affairs, cheating and, you know, falsifying financial returns.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，传统的观点我认为是说，这些人只是爬到顶端的坏人。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 但你所暗示的实际上更复杂，

sentences.en: at one level, the conventional view, I think, is sort of to say these are just people who were bad
sentences.zh: 在某些方面也更令人悲哀，那就是这些人可能不是爬到顶端的坏人，

sentences.en: people who rose to the top.
sentences.zh: 而是爬到顶端的好人，是权力让他们变坏了。

sentences.en: But what you're suggesting is actually something more complex
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这是一个非常引人注目且全面的陈述，尚卡尔，你知道。

sentences.en: and in some ways much sadder, which is that these might not be bad people who rose to the top,
sentences.zh: 这确实与我解读这些社会科学证据的方式一致，

sentences.en: but these might be good people who rose to the top, and power has made them bad.
sentences.zh: 那就是，有几十个实验，我们随机将普通人分配到权力职位或权力较小的职位，

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's such a very compelling and sweeping statement about this, Shankar, you know.
sentences.zh: 你会发现这些模式，如果我只是被随机赋予权力，

sentences.en: That does align with how I read this social scientific evidence,
sentences.zh: 我就会感受到一种随权力而来的扩张性的、你知道的，欣快感和全能感。

sentences.en: which is that, you know, there are dozens of experiments where we randomly assign
sentences.zh: 你知道，我说话更粗鲁。

sentences.en: typical people to either positions of power or less power,
sentences.zh: 我拿走本属于别人的资源。

sentences.en: and you find these patterns where if I'm just randomly given power
sentences.zh: 我更有可能不恰当地调情。

sentences.en: And I feel this sense of sort of expansive, you know, euphoria that comes with power and a sense of omnipotence.
sentences.zh: 我更有可能从事不恰当的性行为。

sentences.en: You know, I speak more rudely.
sentences.zh: 我们有研究表明，当你让某人感到有权力时，他们更有可能在游戏中作弊以赢得50美元。

sentences.en: I take resources that are meant for somebody else.
sentences.zh: 名单还在继续，这确实为阿克顿勋爵（Lord Acton）那句经得起时间考验的古老观察提供了证据，

sentences.en: I'm more likely to flirt inappropriately.
sentences.zh: 那就是权力导致腐败，绝对的权力导致绝对的腐败。

sentences.en: I'm more likely to engage in inappropriate sexual behavior.
sentences.zh: 你在观察各种汽车的驾驶员时也发现了同样的情况。

sentences.en: We have studies showing when you make somebody feel powerful, you're more likely to cheat at a game to win 50 bucks.
sentences.zh: 我听说你做了一个实验，站在十字路口观察谁会在停车标志前停车。

sentences.en: The list goes on, and it really lends credence to Lord Acton's old observation that I think stands the test of time,
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: which is power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You've also found the same thing looking at drivers of various cars.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的意思是，我记得有一天我骑车去上班，差点被一辆黑色奔驰撞到，那家伙，你知道，我是在遵守规则。

sentences.en: I understand you ran an experiment where you stood outside an intersection and saw who stopped at a stop sign.
sentences.zh: 我在加州的一个四向停车区等候并穿过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 那家伙横冲直撞，差点撞到我，他看着我，好像我是平民百姓，应该被赶出路面一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我想，通过观察人们如何开车来测试这些关于权力产生的冲动行为的想法会非常有趣。

sentences.en: You know, I mean, so I remember one day I was biking to work and I almost got hit by a black Mercedes and the guy, you know, and I was in the right.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们在该研究的一个版本中所做的是，我们将一名年轻的伯克利本科生放在伯克利校园旁边的一个行人区。

sentences.en: I sort of waited and gone through this four-way stop area in California.
sentences.zh: 行人区是穿过道路的一条带状区域，给予行人先行权。

sentences.en: And this guy plowed and almost hit me and he looked at me as if, you know, I was the hoi polloi and should be sort of taken off the road.
sentences.zh: 你可以过马路。

sentences.en: And I thought, you know, it'd be really interesting to test these ideas about the impulsive actions that power produces by looking at how people drive.
sentences.zh: 那是白色的斑马线。

sentences.en: So, you know, what we did in one of the versions of this study is we put a young Berkeley undergraduate at a pedestrian zone right next to the Berkeley campus.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进行了编码，我们让这些伯克利的本科生躲在灌木丛中。

sentences.en: The pedestrian zone is this strip that cuts across a road that gives the pedestrian the right of way.
sentences.zh: 一名学生站在行人区。

sentences.en: You get to cross the road.
sentences.zh: 另一名负责编码的学生记录汽车的品牌。

sentences.en: It's white stripes.
sentences.zh: 以及非常简单地，他们是否为行人停车（这是法律），还是直接冲过了行人区？

sentences.en: And then we coded, and we had these Berkeley undergrads kind of hide it in the bushes.
